title: Tanvi Sharma Advances to Denmark Open Quarterfinals
indian_angle: Young Indian shuttler Tanvi Sharma has made a strong statement by reaching the quarterfinals of the Denmark Open.
summary: 17-year-old Tanvi Sharma defeated Yvonne Li to qualify for the quarterfinals of the Denmark Open 2026, where she will face world No.1 An Se Young.

title: Suhas LY Makes Winning Start at Asian Para Games
indian_angle: Indian para-badminton star Suhas LY has commenced his Asian Para Games campaign with a victory.
summary: Suhas LY, a prominent Indian para-badminton player, has secured a winning start in his event at the Asian Para Games.

title: Treesa Jolly-Gayatri Gopichand Enter Denmark Open Quarterfinals
indian_angle: India's promising women's doubles pair, Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand, have advanced to the quarterfinals of the Denmark Open.
summary: Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand defeated an Indonesian pair 21-16, 21-17 to reach the quarterfinals of the Denmark Open, while Kidambi Srikanth's campaign ended.

title: Jagsher Singh Khangurra Assures India a Medal at World Juniors
indian_angle: Jagsher Singh Khangurra's advancement guarantees India a medal at the prestigious BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: Jagsher Singh Khangurra came from behind to defeat Yuan-Syue Jhuang of Chinese Taipei, securing a semi-final spot and a medal for India at the Cairo BWF World Junior Championships.

title: BAI Forms New Athletes Committee for Player Representation
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India has established an Athletes Committee to ensure better representation and involvement of players in decision-making.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee on October 2, 2026, aimed at empowering players within the national badminton framework.

title: National Coaching Camp for World Junior Championships in Guwahati
indian_angle: Indian junior shuttlers are undergoing intensive training at a national camp in Guwahati to prepare for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: A national coaching camp for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 is currently underway at the National Center of Excellence (NCE) in Guwahati, preparing India's young talent.
